goal:
Implement the Lean 4 kernel package at kernel/ for change add-lean-circular-kernel. The contract is openspec/changes/add-lean-circular-kernel/design.md and openspec/changes/add-lean-circular-kernel/specs/lean-kernel/spec.md at commit 2df19e2, accepted by astra-arch-review in reviews/2026-11-08-advise-3.md. Implement that contract. Do not weaken Pure, do not drop coverage, and do not make the interpreter call Direct or Eval.

The package defines de Bruijn terms with var, lam, app, and quote; the Direct relation; the Mogensen-Scott encode; interpreterBody as one closed pure term; the quote-payload route; Represents; metacircular; coverage; and total evalFuel. lake build exits 0. The three open task boxes in tasks.md are checked when those declarations exist.

Lean 4.35.0 is on PATH via ~/.elan/bin (lean, lake, leanc). Put the package under kernel/ so lake build runs there.

Earlier closed node homoiconic-pk4.1: ARCHITECTURE.md records Lean 4 semantics, a Zig host with no evaluator, and no Rust. That partition is already folded. Do not edit it.
non_goals: Initialization, allocation, or a C ABI
Editing the proposal, design, spec delta, or reviews

anchors.invariant: For every quote-free term, Direct at the empty environment agrees with Direct of app interpreterBody (encode p) under Represents. coverage says every interpreter outcome represents a source outcome. evalFuel is sound and complete for Direct, and returns none for omega at every fuel. The interpreter body does not call Direct or Eval.

acceptance.if_true: cd kernel && lake build exits 0. metacircular and coverage are declarations whose axioms exclude sorryAx and any axiom declared by this package. The identity application, the open variable, the unbound function applied to omega, the open lambda, and omega match the scenarios in the spec delta. The three implementation task boxes are checked.
acceptance.if_false: lake build fails, a theorem uses sorry or admit, the interpreter calls Direct or Eval, or a quoted term is a premise of metacircular.

out_of_scope.item: Zig host, initialization, allocation, and the interpreter ABI
